name: @think-space/mcp

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a note in the user's ThinkSpace. Use this instead of just printing useful information in chat: project commands (build/run/test), setup steps, decisions, findings, useful links, gotchas. Title should be short and searchable (e.g. "<project> — commands", "<project> — architecture decisions"). Content is markdown.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List the most recently updated notes in ThinkSpace.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search notes in ThinkSpace by a case-insensitive substring in the title or content. Use before creating a note to avoid duplicates, or to recall previously saved project info.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Get the full content of a single note by id.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Update the title and/or content of an existing note by id.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note in ThinkSpace by id. Permanent.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List canvas boards in ThinkSpace. A board is a visual canvas that can contain notes.

tools.name: add_note_to_board
tools.description: Place an existing note (by note id) onto a canvas board (by board id).

stderr: [thinkspace-mcp] ready (API: https://thinkspace.luscloud.ru/api, tools: create_note, list_notes, search_notes, get_note, update_note, delete_note, list_boards, add_note_to_board)
